purpose: Compile-only API declarations; not runtime implementations

fields.name: LOADING_ERROR
fields.constant: Could not load Finalizer in its own class loader. Loading Finalizer in the current class loader instead. As a result, you will not be able to garbage collect this class loader. To support reclaiming this class loader, either resolve the underlying issue, or move Guava to your system class path.

fields.name: INVALID_ENTRY_MESSAGE
fields.constant: Chunk [%s] is not a valid entry

fields.name: NODE_NOT_IN_GRAPH
fields.constant: Node %s is not an element of this graph.

fields.name: EDGE_NOT_IN_GRAPH
fields.constant: Edge %s is not an element of this graph.

fields.name: NODE_REMOVED_FROM_GRAPH
fields.constant: Node %s that was used to generate this set is no longer in the graph.

fields.name: NODE_PAIR_REMOVED_FROM_GRAPH
fields.constant: Node %s or node %s that were used to generate this set are no longer in the graph.

fields.name: EDGE_REMOVED_FROM_GRAPH
fields.constant: Edge %s that was used to generate this set is no longer in the graph.

fields.name: REUSING_EDGE
fields.constant: Edge %s already exists between the following nodes: %s, so it cannot be reused to connect the following nodes: %s.

fields.name: MULTIPLE_EDGES_CONNECTING
fields.constant: Cannot call edgeConnecting() when parallel edges exist between %s and %s. Consider calling edgesConnecting() instead.

fields.name: PARALLEL_EDGES_NOT_ALLOWED
fields.constant: Nodes %s and %s are already connected by a different edge. To construct a graph that allows parallel edges, call allowsParallelEdges(true) on the Builder.

fields.name: SELF_LOOPS_NOT_ALLOWED
fields.constant: Cannot add self-loop edge on node %s, as self-loops are not allowed. To construct a graph that allows self-loops, call allowsSelfLoops(true) on the Builder.

fields.name: NOT_AVAILABLE_ON_UNDIRECTED
fields.constant: Cannot call source()/target() on a EndpointPair from an undirected graph. Consider calling adjacentNode(node) if you already have a node, or nodeU()/nodeV() if you don't.

fields.name: EDGE_ALREADY_EXISTS
fields.constant: Edge %s already exists in the graph.

fields.name: ENDPOINTS_MISMATCH
fields.constant: Mismatch: endpoints' ordering is not compatible with directionality of the graph

fields.name: MESSAGE
fields.constant: Guava cannot securely create temporary files or directories under SDK versions before Jelly Bean. You can create one yourself, either in the insecure default directory or in a more secure directory, such as context.getCacheDir(). For more information, see the Javadoc for Files.createTempDir().

fields.name: MUST_BE_THROWABLE
fields.constant: The Nestable implementation passed to the NestableDelegate(Nestable) constructor must extend java.lang.Throwable

fields.name: DEFAULT_TARGET

fields.name: RETURN_METHOD_TARGET
fields.constant: The return value of this method
